title: Span and Trace Vocabulary
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Span and Trace Vocabulary.
learning_objectives: Explain span and trace vocabulary using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for span and trace vocabulary
Assess failure and operational limits of span and trace vocabulary
concepts_covered: A span is one timed operation; a trace groups related spans and parent IDs describe nesting.
Span carries trace/span/parent IDs, service, operation, start, duration, and status.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
